response.text: {"label": "wrong_self_check", "reason": "The stimulus reaches the target scenario: the false start is rejected (sub `168 ... rx busy_rise 0` / `176 ... rx busy_fall 0`), 3C is handshaken (`178 ... rx hs 3c`) and A5 completes (`332 ... rx hs a5`). But with tready still high, tvalid for A5 pulses mid-stop-bit while uart_rx_send_byte is still waiting, so the later `wait (m_axis_tvalid && m_axis_tdata == 8'hA5)` never sees it and hangs until the $fatal timeout."}
